proposal.light_setup: 420 nm LED, 100 mW/cm2 intensity, wrapped around coil

streams.contents: Fmoc-L-methionine (0.10 M) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) in Acetonitrile

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: T-mixer creates segmented or annular flow to maximize interfacial area for oxygen transfer from air to the liquid phase before entering the photoreactor.
proposal.pre_reactor_steps: 1. Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and photocatalyst in acetonitrile to 0.10 M. 2. Degas acetonitrile if necessary to remove dissolved gases that might interfere, though air is the reactant. 3. Load solution into Syringe Pump A. 4. Set Air MFC to 50 sccm.
proposal.post_reactor_steps: 1. Pass effluent through a gas-liquid separator (not in inventory, assumed standard lab setup) to remove air. 2. Collect liquid product. 3. Analyze by HPLC/LC-MS for conversion and yield.
proposal.chemistry_notes: Batch yield was 99% in 5 min. Flow residence time is set to 5 min to match. Gas flow is set to 50 sccm to ensure excess oxygen availability. Pressure is kept low (1 bar) to facilitate gas-liquid mixing but high enough to prevent cavitation.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Matched to batch time of 5 min for direct comparison.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Set to 1.0 mL/min to achieve 5 min residence time in 5 mL reactor. This is well above the 0.01 mL/min minimum.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Selected 5 mL coil to allow for 5 min residence time at 1 mL/min. Smaller volume than 10 mL option to reduce solvent waste.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_sccm: 50 sccm is a conservative estimate for air flow to ensure oxygen saturation without causing excessive pressure drop or channeling.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 1 bar backpressure ensures liquid phase stability and prevents gas expansion issues, while remaining low to aid mass transfer.

proposal.literature_analogies: Photo-oxidation of sulfides to sulfoxides using visible light and air is a known transformation. Flow chemistry enhances this by improving gas-liquid mass transfer compared to batch stirring.
safety_flags: Acetonitrile is flammable and toxic. Ensure proper ventilation.
UV/Visible light exposure: Ensure reactor is properly shielded.
Pressurized gas: Ensure all fittings are rated for 20 bar.

disposition_rationale: The batch protocol relies on air exposure for oxidation. In flow, mass transfer of oxygen from gas to liquid is the rate-limiting step compared to the fast photochemical excitation. A conservative screen is required to determine if the chosen gas-liquid mixing regime and residence time provide sufficient oxygen saturation to achieve the 99% yield observed in batch. The design uses the smallest available reactor volume to minimize solvent use and maximize surface-area-to-volume ratio for gas-liquid contact, while adhering to the minimum flow rate constraint.
